question_text: An industrial gate has an obstruction sensor. Explain how an interrupt handler can respond safely when it detects an object during closing.
adaptation_rationale: ISR and actuator control retain CPU/control-system reasoning. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: The CPU transfers control to the sensor ISR; it evaluates the event and sends a stop/reverse signal to the motor actuator before normal work resumes.

marking_points.criterion: Control output stops/reverses actuator to prevent collision.
